title: Voynich manuscript
caveat: These are questions about the material that can be measured before anyone proposes a reading. Answering all of them would not decipher the script; it would make a later claim testable. Nothing here is a reading, and no probability of decipherment is assigned.

lay.tagline: A 15th-century illustrated book in a script nobody can read.
lay.summary: The Voynich manuscript is a book of about 240 pages held at Yale, written in an unknown script and full of drawings of plants, stars and bathing figures. Its vellum has been carbon dated to the early 1400s. Nobody knows whether it hides a real language, a cipher or no meaning at all. We have not proposed a reading. The plan is to measure first how much the statistics change when you change how the script is transcribed.
lay.what_it_is: The script uses perhaps 20 to 30 distinct signs, written in what look like words. Researchers turn it into Roman letters using schemes such as EVA, but those letters are labels for shapes, not sounds, and different schemes split the signs differently.
lay.what_we_found: Three of four structural questions are measured and the first cipher-shaped test now has both of its declared measurements. The declared statistics survive both transcription choice and word segmentation (glyph frequency agreement 0.999; sign frequencies exactly invariant under every segmentation). The held-out test answered yes: unseen folios are predicted better than every one of 1,000 declared shuffles, with the transferable structure concentrating inside words. The substitution screen's first pass was indeterminate by its own declared rule; its calibrated pass then measured the cross-text penalty at only 0.018 to 0.060 nats per pair, and the real text stood below the calibrated band in all six (file, language) cells, by roughly 2 to 10 times that penalty, in all three transcriptions. The band was then widened to three English and four Latin class members (including the period-appropriate 1485 Malory and three centuries of Latin prose), every one of 35 seeded plants stayed above the real text in all six cells, and the period-appropriate member scored strongest rather than weakest, so archaic style does not explain the gap. A trigram-resolution re-scoring of the same band then found the same shape again: thirty planted substitutions recovered their anchors exactly, the destroyed-adjacency floors stayed below the real text, and the real text sat below every best-recovered band member in all six cells by 3.6 to 8.8 times the measured cross-text penalty - trigrams carry about three times the bigram resolution, and the verdicts split three to three only because six stuck computer-draws on one reference text (a disclosed machinery artifact, recorded as such) gave the rule a lower anchor at noise level. The declared fifth measurement then re-ran the same band under a raised 48-restart budget with a declared per-text convergence criterion, so band membership rests only on machine draws that agree, and the real text stayed below the entered band in all six (file, language) cells - by 0.53 to 1.19 nats per trigram - with thirty planted substitutions again at exact parity and the real above the floors. The measured verdict per the rule declared in advance: the scoped class - simple one-to-one substitution of a sampled English or Latin prose with carried word divisions - is excluded by count for the manuscript's statistics as measured, at bigram and trigram resolution alike. Family 5, homophonic substitution, then took its first declared measurement: with the mapped alphabet widened to 36 glyphs plus the word mark and a reassignment search that lets several cipher symbols share one letter, the machinery's recovered scores exceed their own planted anchors everywhere (a disclosed, systematic exploitation of the add-one model under the richer search space), and the real text's best stands above the homophonic band in all six cells - so the declared rule's verdicts say consistent-with-substitution, which under the declared exclusion format leaves the family open and excludes nothing: the screen cannot under this machinery separate the manuscript's statistics from the sampled encodings, and no cipher identification is claimed. All four pre-reading question families are answered or measured with shown power; abbreviated scribal usage, the homophonic separation question just described, word-level ciphers, transpositions and other schemes remain outside what was measured. No conclusion about language or meaning is drawn, nothing is a reading, and no mapping is published. A held-out re-scoring under the repaired exact search, with every recovered assignment priced only on pairs its climb never saw, then re-measured the same six cells: the verdicts stayed consistent-with-substitution (the real's held-out values still stand above every member's drawn value, all thirty plants pass, and the exploitation is disclosed as systematic across the split because planted encodings hold the same 0.39 to 0.50 excess on held-out data too), so the family stays open, nothing is excluded, and no cipher identification is claimed. The declared surplus-capacity ladder then re-measured all six cells at 36, 33, 30 and 27 glyph slots plus the boundary mark and answered its declared question no on both parts: the real's margin does not shrink as the alphabet's surplus is removed (five of six cells end at or above their starting margin) and no rung separates the real from the band, so the margin is not fed by the surplus homophone slots and the family stays open. The declared shape-priced re-measure then rebuilt the score table itself in a leave-one-out form - every occurring pair type scored with one occurrence of itself removed, the unseen-type floor unchanged, a bridge gate proving the measurement's code field-for-field identical under the inherited table before the new cells ran - and answered its declared question yes: the real's margin above the band survives the re-pricing (five of six margins move at most 0.0003 nats and the weakest, GC latin, widens by 0.0284), so the margin is not the add-one table's shape, and the family stays open. The declared block-fold split then replaced the parity interleave with contiguous halves - the climb half the first floor(N/2) pairs, the score half the remainder the search never sees, fresh in the span sense and not only the pair sense - and answered its declared question yes: every one of the six margins widens under the span-fresh pricing (by 0.0030 to 0.0517), the real's held-out value improves in all six cells, and where an encoding's climb-half exploitation failed to carry to the second span the instrument recorded it, so the separation is not an artifact of the split's geometry either and the family stays open.
lay.whats_next: Family 5 stays open at priority 1: three declared instrument changes (surplus capacity removed, leave-one-out table, block-fold split) have left every margin standing or wider, so the declared next instrument is a widened band population - additional class members per language frozen under the declared corpus rules with identical processing, extending the band, then re-measuring the six cells' real above the wider band under the block split and the leave-one-out table to test whether the separation holds as the band's population grows.

faq.q: Has the Voynich manuscript been deciphered?
faq.a: No. Many readings have been announced; none has been shown to work on pages its author did not use to build it.
It is not settled. The vellum is old, but that does not tell us whether the text means anything.

researcher.summary: Beinecke MS 408. Transliteration ZL 3b (IVTFF 2.0, 13 May 2025) from voynich.nu, to be compared with a second independently authored transliteration. Planned statistics: sign n-grams of orders 1 to 4, token lengths and line-position effects under each declared segmentation, with at most 2,000 seeded nulls preserving word lengths or line lengths, and 10 reserved folios.
methods: Declared substitution screen with plant and floor bands

statuses.closed-with-power: Answered with a control: measured on a frozen corpus, with a solved or synthetic control showing the method works.
statuses.tested-without-power: Measured without a control: a number exists, but no control shows what it would look like if the answer were different.
statuses.excluded-by-count: Excluded by a count: the class's own members score clearly above what the manuscript shows, with the machinery's power demonstrated on planted and destroyed controls.
statuses.open: Open: proposed here, not yet measured.

families.family: Do the statistics survive a change of transcription?
families.evidence: Measured 20 October 2026 on the 5,013 worded loci shared by ZL 3b and IT 2a outside ten reserved whole folios. Spearman rank correlation over shared types: glyph frequency 0.999, bigrams 0.965, trigrams 0.937, quadgrams 0.915, word tokens 0.901. Glyph totals match within 218 of 184,310; the files split 34,354 and 36,441 tokens (6.1 percent), so the residue is segmentation, not the statistics. Controls: the within-file half-split resampling baseline is 0.73 for word tokens and 0.84 to 1.00 for the rest, so the cross-transcription agreement is at or above the metric's own ceiling; a planted cyclic relabelling of the ten most frequent EVA characters of IT drops bigram agreement to 0.40, trigrams to 0.10, quadgrams to -0.07 and words to 0.26, margins of 0.56 or more; planted miniature files control the pipeline itself. Nothing follows about language or meaning.

families.family: Do they survive a change of word segmentation?
families.evidence: Measured 20 October 2026 on the same 5,013 worded shared loci under two declared segmentations: the frozen long-word convention (delegated to the frozen parser and locked to it on every locus of all three files) and the identical normalisation with every uncertain space cut as definite. IT carries no uncertain spaces, so its two policies agree exactly: a built-in zero-join control. ZL has 2,603 joins: tokens 34,354 to 36,957, the delta exactly the join count; word types fall 8,988 to 7,959 (splitting recycles joined hapaxes, so a large share of measured vocabulary size is segmentation); mean length 5.365 to 4.987. GC behaves the same with 2,321 joins. Sign frequencies are exactly invariant (delta 0 in every file). Word-frequency ranks move to rho 0.942 (ZL) and 0.947 (GC) between their own two policies, not collapse. Cross-file ZL-IT agreement holds at 0.90 or better at every order under both policies, and the split values are all at or above the long-word values (word tokens 0.901 to 0.915), so family 1's conclusion does not depend on segmentation. Planted synthetic loci reproduce the exact token-delta identity. No reading and no language claim.

families.family: Does the text predict unseen folios better than shuffled text?
families.evidence: Measured 20 October 2026 under pre-declared statistics, nulls, seeds and verdict rules. Ten whole folios reserved statistics-blind (f87r, f96v, f95r2, f68v1, f32v, f106r, f67r1, f36r, f82v, f24r) were scored against 1,000 seeded permutations per cell in three files of independent authorship: every cell's real statistic sat below all 1,000 null values, p 0.0010, the budget's floor. Within-word glyph-order structure transferred at 30 to 39 percent below the null floor; word-adjacency structure transferred weakly but beyond all noise at 0.5 to 0.8 percent below the null floor, so most transferable structure lives inside words. Machinery power demonstrated in both directions on planted synthetic corpora; stored null heads and real statistics recompute exactly from the declared per-replicate seeds. This is a necessary condition for language-like structure, not a sufficient one; no language, cipher or meaning conclusion follows. The reservation's testing role is discharged; family 4 must declare its own held-out discipline.

families.family: Is it a simple cipher of a known language?
families.evidence: First measurement 20 October 2026: the declared substitution screen (one-to-one substitution with carried word divisions, the alphabet's cipher symbols inside the file's most frequent glyph characters up to 26 plus the word-boundary mark, add-one bigram scoring, greedy swap search with 16 seeded restarts, plants and floors per cell) against two frozen reference proeses, English (Pride and Prejudice, Gutenberg 1342) and Latin (Augustinus Confessiones, Gutenberg 33849). All six (file, language) cells scored indeterminate per the declared rule: real best sits 0.11 to 0.31 nats per counted pair below plant self-parity and 1.17 to 1.33 nats per counted pair above its own destroyed-adjacency floors, consistent across ZL, GC and IT. Plants reached parity exactly 20 of 20 times, so the machinery recognizes a substitution when the material is one. Second measurement the same day, the declared cross-text calibration against second reference proeses (English: Frankenstein, Gutenberg 84; Latin: C. Iuli Caesaris De Bello Gallico I-IV, Gutenberg 218): the measured cross-text penalty is only 0.018 to 0.060 nats per pair, and the real text stands below the cross band in all six cells, by 0.094 to 0.189 nats per pair (English) and 0.159 to 0.254 (Latin) - roughly 2 to 10 times the measured cross penalty - with the Latin cross plants cut shorter than the real streams and still scoring above them. Verdict per the declared rule: below-cross-band, all six cells. Not yet family closure: the band is two proeses per language and period styles are outside the sampled population (abbreviated scribal usage remains outside the declared class). Not covered by either unit: homophonic or polyalphabetic substitution, word-level ciphers, transpositions, nulls, abbreviations. No mapping is published; nothing here is a reading. Third measurement 21 October 2026, the declared widened band declared after the cross screen and before this run: five added class members frozen with sha256 provenance and identical declared processing - English: Moby Dick (Gutenberg 2701) and Le Morte D'Arthur volume 1 (the 1485 Caxton prose, the band's period-appropriate member, Gutenberg 1251); Latin: Vulgate Daniel (828), Colloquium heptaplomeres (17859), and De Rariorum Animalium atque Stirpium Historia (27655). The cross screen's own texts replay their declared per-plant seeds and recompute their cross-artifact values exactly; the added texts use declared sequential rngs per (file, language, text). All 35 plants converged to one value each, the band's weakest edge moved from -5.1345 (Caesar) to -5.2063 (Rariorum) in Latin and from -5.1603 (Frankenstein) to -5.1893 (Moby Dick) in English, and the real text still stands below every band member in all six cells, now by 0.064 to 0.165 nats per pair (English) and 0.087 to 0.182 (Latin), still 1.17 to 1.33 above the recomputed floors. The period-appropriate Malory scored the strongest plant values (about -5.10), not the weakest, so archaic style does not explain the gap at bigram resolution; the band's weakest members are the two short Latin texts (under 78 thousand symbols against the real streams' 218k to 220k), yet their plants still score above the real text under that length handicap. Verdict per the rule declared before the run: below-widened-band, all six cells. Not yet family closure: the sampled population is three English and four Latin proeses, not the class. Not covered by any unit: homophonic or polyalphabetic substitution, word-level ciphers, transpositions, nulls, abbreviations. No mapping is published; nothing here is a reading. Fourth measurement the same day, the declared trigram resolution pass declared in its docstring before the run: identical streams, mapped set and search machinery, re-scored under the declared add-one trigram model of the first references (P(third | first, second) = (n + 1) / (n(second pair) + 27)). Self-parity plants reached their truncated-stream anchors exactly (30 of 30), every floor stayed below the real by 0.36 to 0.72 nats per trigram, and the real text stands below every best-recovered band member in all six cells by 0.5321 to 1.0763 nats per trigram, which is 3.6 to 8.8 times the measured trigram cross-text penalty (0.121 to 0.147 nats per trigram). The declared rule's verdict strings split - three English cells consistent-with-substitution, three Latin cells below-trigram-band - through a disclosed machinery reason: six of forty-five English cross-plant draws (five Moby Dick, one Frankenstein in GC) stuck near the floors' region on identical data whose healthy draws recover about 0.9 nats higher, so the English rule outcome rode on stuck draws rather than member statistics, while all Latin draws converged within 0.0001. The class is not excluded by this artifact's rule alone; the declared next instrument is the noise-controlled trigram band. Fifth measurement the same day, the noise-controlled trigram band declared in its docstring before the run, with the exclusion format itself declared in advance: the identical streams, model and search re-measured under a 48-restart budget applied to the real, every plant and every floor, plus the declared per-text convergence criterion (a band member enters the band only when its five plant draws agree to within 0.0001 nats; failing texts are recorded with their spread and do not set the threshold). All 30 self-parity plants re-converged to their truncated anchors exactly, the real re-measured under the same budget improved in two cells (ZL english -3.0925 to -3.0514, GC latin -2.9182 to -2.8934), and the 16-restart budget's six stuck draws shrank to four (one Frankenstein draw in GC, two Moby Dick draws in GC, one in IT), all disclosed and all excluded from threshold-setting as declared; Moby Dick entered the ZL english band with all five draws at exactly -2.0449. The real text stands below the smallest entered-band value in all six cells by 1.0065 (ZL english), 1.0480 (GC english), 1.1879 (IT english), 0.6881 (ZL latin), 0.7347 (GC latin) and 0.5321 (IT latin) nats per counted trigram, and above the largest floor by 0.36 to 0.72. Verdict per the declared rule: below-controlled-band, all six cells. Per the declared format: the scoped class - one-to-one substitution of a known language, word divisions carried, no abbreviation, no transposition, no nulls, within the sampled population of seven reference proeses - is excluded by count for the manuscript's statistics as measured, at bigram and trigram resolution alike. Standing caveats: abbreviated scribal usage outside the class, population sampled not exhaustive, reference texts are modern printed proeses, nothing here is a reading, no mapping published, plaintext_recovered_percent remains 0. Not covered by the family's exclusion: homophonic or polyalphabetic substitution, word-level ciphers, transpositions, nulls, abbreviations.

families.family: Is it a homophonic substitution of a known language?
families.evidence: First measurement 21 October 2026, the declared homophonic screen declared in engine/voynich_homophonic.py's docstring before any run: the identical frozen streams, references and add-one bigram table as family 4, the mapped set widened before the run to the file's most frequent glyph characters up to 36 plus the word-boundary mark (37 cipher symbols over the model's 27 letter tokens), scored by a declared greedy reassignment hill-climb over assignments from cipher symbols onto letter tokens (sweep cap 200, restarts 16, both inherited, the best assignment's score re-evaluated exactly). A disclosed pre-run design probe found the add-one model exploitable under the richer assignment space - a climb from a planted configuration's own key rises above that key's score and keeps improving at the declared cap - so the cap is a declared budget applied identically to both sides, every machinery call records its cap hit, and plants pass when their best is at least the anchor minus 0.0001 with best-above-anchor counted as parity and its excess recorded (machinery-above-anchor). Plants: five per (file, language), encodings of the truncated first reference through a declared partition and sampler rule, anchors algebraically the truncated stream's identity score. Floors: five destroyed-adjacency shuffles per cell. Cross band: the seven family 4 widened members encoded under the same rules, membership declared unconditional, a member's value its five-draw machinery best. Measured: all 30 plants pass with excesses 0.3922 to 0.4970 nats per counted pair; every floor stays below the real by 0.69 to 0.99; the real re-measured at -4.4149 to -4.5027 nats per counted pair stands ABOVE the smallest band member value in all six (file, language) cells by 0.1061 to 0.3494; all six verdicts per the declared rule are consistent-with-substitution; all 101 machinery calls hit the declared sweep cap. Consequence per the declared exclusion format: the class is not excluded - the format required the real below the band everywhere - and family 5 stays open. The disclosed reading of the direction: band members sit 0.46 to 0.62 above their own anchors and the real gained 0.79 to 1.00 over its family 4 bigram-screen values, so the rule's consistent verdicts ride on the machinery's disclosed systematic exploitation of the add-one table under the wider search space, which this artifact does NOT read as a positive identification of a cipher; the screen cannot separate the manuscript's statistics from the sampled homophonic encodings under this machinery. No mapping is published; nothing here is a reading; plaintext_recovered_percent stays 0. Family 4's exclusion stands untouched. Second measurement 21 October 2026, the declared held-out homophonic screen declared in the module docstring before any run: after a disclosed probe finding - the first screen's candidate rule was exact only at the current label and erred elsewhere by n times (table[l, c] + table[c, l] - 2 table[l, l]) with its stored numbers untouched because the best assignment was always re-evaluated exactly - the machinery was repaired to an exact greedy reassignment climb (candidates the exact new totals with the self-pair correction, the running best exact, adoption strict beyond 1e-12), verified against brute force to 9.1e-13; every side's counted pairs then split by declared pair-index parity into a climb half the search may use and a score half it may never touch, the halves sharing no counted pair and interleaved across halves (every interior position carries one climbed pair and one scored pair, so the score half is fresh to the search in the pair sense, not an independent sample), the reported number the chosen assignment's exact mean nats per scored pair on the score half and no assignment stored anywhere. A second disclosed pre-run probe found the exploitation systematic across the split: planted encodings hold 0.39 to 0.50 nats above their truth keys on held-out data too, so the held-out statistic prices only the data-specific component. Measured: all 30 plants pass parity with held-out excesses 0.391 to 0.499; every floor stays 0.736 to 0.879 below the real; the real's held-out values -4.3534 to -4.4318 nats per scored pair stand 0.1763 to 0.3455 above the smallest member value in all six (file, language) cells, so all six verdicts are consistent-with-substitution again; and all 342 machinery calls (16 exact restarts each, 5,472 exact climbs) converged with zero cap hits, so no stored number is a budget truncation. The direction question the held-out design posed is answered no: the verdicts do not reverse when exploitation's data-specific volume is priced out, the declared exclusion format excludes nothing, and the family stays open with the disclosure that both sides exploit the add-one table systematically under this instrument, no cipher identification claimed. A side instrument - the same exact climb over the unsplit data, recorded for attribution only - reaches the first screen's stored plant values and sometimes beyond, consistent with the drift having lived in the search path only. Nothing here is a reading; no mapping is published; plaintext_recovered_percent stays 0. The third measurement, recorded 21 October 2026, is the declared surplus-capacity ladder: the same six cells, split, seeds, exact machinery, anchors and band re-measured as the mapped budget steps down through 36, 33, 30 and 27 glyph slots plus the word-boundary mark, the real re-rendered per budget through the declared top-B rule (characters outside the rung's set dropped with their adjacency, IT's 23-glyph pool taking its full set at every rung so IT's real stream never changes), plants and band members re-encoded per budget through the declared partition rule from their declared kinds, floors replayed per rung on the rung's real stream, and the rung at 36 verified field for field against the frozen held-out artifact (421 fields compared) before the narrower rungs ran. The declared truthful question is answered no on both parts: the real's margin above the band does not shrink as the surplus is removed (margins 0.2745 to 0.3015 to 0.2461 to 0.3038 on ZL english, 0.2338 to 0.2333 across the latin ladder with a single -0.0499 to +0.0500 oscillation, 0.3455 to 0.4469 on GC english, 0.1763 to 0.2191 on GC latin, 0.3114 to 0.3420 on IT english, 0.2374 to 0.2356 on IT latin; five of six cells end the ladder at or above their starting margin) and no rung separates any cell: all 24 rung-cell verdicts are consistent-with-substitution, the real holding 0.1763 to 0.4469 nats per scored pair above the smallest member value at every rung. The real's held-out value is essentially rung-flat (at most 0.0732 nats of movement across the whole ladder; IT's real exactly constant) while band maxima narrow by a few hundredths without ever reaching the real, the floors stay 0.7359 at the closest below the real at every rung, all 120 plant rungs pass parity, and not one machinery call hit the declared sweep cap. The instrument's disclosure adds one more no-surprise: the disclosed add-one exploitation is not fed by the surplus homophone slots, and the margin's remaining suspect is the model's shape; the family's exclusion format is untouched and the family stays open. The fourth measurement, recorded 21 October 2026, is the declared shape-priced re-measure: the held-out screen's six (file, language) cells, plants, floors and band re-measured at the top budget with the mapped set, streams, held-out split, seed kinds, machinery, restart and sweep budgets unchanged and the declared score table rebuilt in an exploitation-resistant leave-one-out form - every pair type (a, b) present in the reference pair table scored with one occurrence of (a, b) removed from the reference counts, log(n_ab/(N + 728)) against the add-one form's log((n_ab + 1)/(N + 729)), a type with no counted occurrence keeping the inherited add-one entry, every occurring type re-priced one occurrence more severely, the unseen-type floor unchanged, the letter marginals and rank initialisation unchanged, and the declared conditional on re-deriving the matrix arithmetic resolved as not needed because the model stays the reference's aggregate and the score one fixed 27 x 27 table per language. A declared bridge gate, rehearsed as a pre-run probe and enforced in code before the leave-one-out cells ran, verified this measurement's full first cell (ZL english: real, five plants, five floors and three band members) under the inherited add-one table equal to the held-out screen's own outputs field for field (57 fields), so the only difference from the frozen measurement is the scoring table; the encodings and floor shuffles are byte-identical replays of the frozen draws. The declared truthful question is answered yes: the real's margin above the band survives a model the climb cannot feed on. All six verdicts are consistent-with-substitution under the leave-one-out form; the margins are 0.2743 (ZL english), 0.2338 (ZL latin), 0.3114 (IT english), 0.2373 (IT latin), 0.3452 (GC english) and 0.2047 (GC latin) nats per scored pair, moved from the add-one run's 0.2745, 0.2338, 0.3114, 0.2374, 0.3455 and 0.1763 by at most 0.0003 nats in five cells while the sixth - GC latin, the screen's and ladder's weakest margin - widened by 0.0284 as the real's own held-out value improved 0.0283 under the re-priced table (-4.4318 to -4.4035) while its band holds within 0.0001. The real's held-out value moves at most 0.0005 nats in the five other cells (band members at most 0.0016, anchors at most 0.0013), the repricing concentrates on rare types (largest single-entry shift log 2 at count-1 types; mean -0.065165 english and -0.083226 latin over occurring types), and the reference's clean identity means move only 0.0005 to 0.0007 nats. All 30 plants pass parity with machinery-above-anchor excesses 0.3916 to 0.4989, unchanged in scale from the held-out screen, every floor stays 0.7640 to 0.8782 below the real, and not one of the 342 machinery calls in the six cells, plus the bridge gate's 104 field-for-field re-derivations, hit the declared sweep cap. The disclosure the shape artifact adds: the margin is not carried by the add-one table's shape - re-pricing every occurring pair type more severely leaves the separation standing and even widens its weakest instance - while the disclosed systematic exploitation of the machinery is unchanged in scale on both sides, so the margin rides the statistics themselves as this instrument prices them, no cipher identification claimed. The family's exclusion format is untouched and the family stays open. The fifth measurement, recorded 21 October 2026, is the declared block-fold split: the shape measurement's six (file, language) cells, plants, floors and band re-measured at the top budget under the leave-one-out table with the mapped set, streams, seed kinds, machinery, restart and sweep budgets unchanged and the declared split replaced by the contiguous block fold - each side's counted pairs in stream order split at the midpoint, the first floor(N/2) pairs the climb half the machinery may search, the remaining pairs the score half it may never touch, for an odd count the climb half taking the smaller first block, the halves sharing no counted pair and every identity anchor's halves folding by the same rule, so the scored pairs are fresh to the search in the span sense and not only the pair sense, the held-out split's disclosed residual. A declared bridge gate, rehearsed as a pre-run probe and enforced in code before the block cells ran, verified this measurement's full first cell (ZL english: real, five plants, five floors and three band members) under the inherited pair-index-parity split equal to the shape measurement's own outputs field for field (60 fields), so the only difference from the frozen shape measurement is the split; the encodings and floor shuffles are byte-identical replays of the frozen draws. The declared truthful question is answered yes: the real's held-out score-half value still stands above the band when the scored pairs are fresh to the search in the span sense. All six verdicts are consistent-with-substitution under the block fold; the margins are 0.3123 (ZL english), 0.2416 (ZL latin), 0.3631 (IT english), 0.2407 (IT latin), 0.3591 (GC english) and 0.2077 (GC latin) nats per scored pair against the shape measurement's parity margins 0.2743, 0.2338, 0.3114, 0.2373, 0.3452 and 0.2047 - every margin widens under the span-fresh pricing, by 0.0030 to 0.0517, and the weakest margin stays GC latin at 0.2077. The real's held-out value improves in every cell under the block fold (IT english -4.3880 to -4.3735 the largest move) while the band's smallest member value degrades in two cells (the english2 member ZL -4.6999 to -4.7368 and IT -4.6994 to -4.7366, its selected draw's climb-half exploitation no longer carrying to the second span) and holds within 0.006 elsewhere, so those two margins widen from both directions; the six identity anchors move 0.0015 to 0.0107 against the frozen parity anchors, every block score half the more favourable. Block halves: ZL 218,415 pairs into 109,207 climb and 109,208 score, GC 183,199 into 91,599 and 91,600, IT 220,531 into 110,265 and 110,266. All 30 plants pass parity with excesses 0.3866 to 0.4933, unchanged in scale, every floor stays 0.7648 to 0.8901 below the real, and not one of the 342 machinery calls in the six cells, plus the bridge gate's 104 field-for-field re-derivations, hit the declared sweep cap. The disclosure the split artifact adds: the margin has now survived three declared instrument changes without shrinking (the surplus capacity's removal, the leave-one-out table, the span-fresh block fold), and the block fold is the harsher geometry - wherever an encoding's climb-half exploitation failed to carry to the second span the instrument recorded it, while the real's values improved everywhere - so the separation is not an artifact of the parity geometry's interleaving either, and the remaining declared suspects are the band's population breadth and the reference corpus scope, no cipher identification claimed. The family's exclusion format is untouched and the family stays open.
families.next: Declare a widened band population at the top budget before any run: freeze additional class members per language under the declared corpus rules (modern printed prose, declared provenance, sha256 recorded, identical declared processing to the standing members), extend the declared band with them, and re-measure the six cells' real above that wider band under the block-fold split and the leave-one-out table with everything else unchanged, to test whether the separation holds as the band's population grows; the family stays open unless the declared exclusion format fires.
